_readme: Hand-tuned placement overrides for the chatt twin's sampled buildings (#259). Keyed by model slug; fields: yawDeg | scale | yOffset (replace), dx | dz (additive ENU-metre nudges), exclude (drop from emit). Produced by the in-viewer placement editor's Export button (?edit) — paste its clipboard JSON here, then re-run scripts/warehouse/emit-models.ts.

4th-and-market-street-downtown-chattanoo._why: pathological source GLB: 3.4MB for 400 tris even after texture stripping; also fails meshopt encode AND re-read. Anonymous corner block, not a landmark.

chattanooga-choo-choo-hotel-2._why: duplicate of the shared ~431×283m Choo-Choo campus all six choo-choo models carry — six overlapping copies at one anchor were the worst z-fight in the city (iter 5). One copy ships: chattanooga-choo-choo-hotel-1.
